# Danny Devaney — The Ping Pong Ball Guy

> Comedian, juggler and entertainer known for clean comedy and audience participation.

Canonical website: https://danny-devaney-the-show.nielsduinker.chatgpt.site/

## About Danny
Danny Devaney is a Ringling Bros. and Barnum & Bailey Clown College graduate. His career includes circus touring, Walt Disney World, Disney Cruise Line, WonderWorks Orlando and The Comedy Barn Theater in Pigeon Forge, Tennessee. He has performed more than 20,000 live shows over a career of more than 30 years.

## Signature routines
Ping-Pong Balls, Danger Juggling, Buckets, Straitjacket Escape and Spinning Plates.
